visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a man wearing a blue cap and a beige long-sleeved shirt sitting at a wooden table. He is holding a shiny, silver-colored metal container and showing it to the camera. Behind him is a large TV screen displaying a forge or factory scene with high contrast. (2) He sets the container down and picks up a long, flat wooden spoon, turning it over to show its texture and design. The table is clean and the lighting is warm and bright. (3) He then displays a thin metal card holder, sliding it open and shut. Various items like a wrapped utensil and a cardboard box are visible on the table. (4) The man lifts a metal sandwich maker from its packaging, showing its handle and plates. (5) He presents a Japanese kitchen knife resting on its red presentation box, pulling it out slightly to show the blade and markings. (6) A series of close-up montage shots show the kettle, spoon, and other metal crafts resting on the table under bright studio-like lighting. (7) The scene transitions to several infographic slides with white backgrounds, showcasing a wide range of Tsubame-Sanjo products including kettles, cutlery, and specialized tools. (8) Finally, the man is back on screen, gesturing with his hands as he speaks directly to the camera, inviting the audience to an event.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這個水壺是我之前從燕三條買回來的. [Logo]: 鍛造. (2) [Subtitle]: 這個咖哩的湯匙也是我之前從燕三條那個地方帶回來的. (3) [Subtitle]: 這金屬製的名片盒也是我去燕三條的時候偷偷給它買過來的. (4) [Subtitle]: 還有這個烤吐司的加熱器，它也是我去燕三條買來的. (5) [Subtitle]: 還有這個迷宮飯聯名的菜刀，也是我當時在燕三條的時候把它帶回來的. [Variety]: 新產品開發強勢推薦. (6) [Subtitle]: 現在你不用跑到燕三條你就可以去買到很多燕三條的東西嗎. (7) [Subtitle]: 因為從3月13號開始到3月16號在台北的松菸之間的展覽. (8) [Subtitle]: 總共會有48位日本人會來台灣. (9) [Subtitle]: 裡面有包含許多都是社長還有公司裡面重要的經理人或者是重要的幹部. (10) [Subtitle]: 全部都是燕三條的文化跟燕三條的東西跟台灣做交流. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後重點是3月13號那天我會親自為大家帶導覽. (12) [Subtitle]: 如果你有空的話歡迎你翹班一起來看.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional invitation for a cultural and industrial exchange exhibition titled 'Between Visions' featuring products from Tsubame-Sanjo, Japan. The creator showcases high-quality metalware items he previously acquired to establish credibility and interest, then details the upcoming event at Songshan Cultural and Creative Park in Taipei, promising a personal guided tour to encourage attendance.
